title: Neom Wellbeing CEO Isabel Malbois exits the business after five years
summary: Malbois will depart the British wellbeing and home fragrance brand this month, with Neom Wellbeing co-founder Oliver Mennell returning to lead the company as Executive Chair

extraction.key_fact: Neom Wellbeing CEO가 회사를 떠나고 공동 창업자가 회장으로 돌아와 회사를 이끈다.
